# 50agents

> 50agents is a product from viaSocket. You tell Captain, its AI, what you need in plain words, and it builds automations, AI agents, browser agents and apps that do the work in your real apps, with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits.

## Links

- [Home](https://50agents.com/): what 50agents is and how it works.
- [Sign up](https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login): create a free workspace, or sign in.
- [Full context (llms-full.txt)](https://50agents.com/llms-full.txt): entire public site guide in one file.
- [NLWeb /ask](https://50agents.com/ask): natural-language query over public content.

## For AI agents

- [AI catalog](https://50agents.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): every machine-readable resource on this site.
- [Agent skills](https://50agents.com/.well-known/agent-skills.json): what an agent can do here today.
- [Home in markdown](https://50agents.com/index.md) and [pricing in markdown](https://50agents.com/pricing.md).
- Open Captain with a job already typed: https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login?draft=<the job, URL-encoded>. The person signs in and taps Build it.
- [Sitemap index](https://50agents.com/sitemap.xml): every indexed page, one sitemap per family.

## Apps, in depth

Everything you can do with each app on 50agents, by chore, with asks that open Captain.

- [A Gmail AI agent that clears your inbox chores for you](https://50agents.com/integrations/gmail) ([markdown](https://50agents.com/integrations/gmail.md)): With 50agents, a Gmail AI agent reads new email, drafts replies in your voice, labels and files messages, pulls out attachments and logs what matters to a sheet, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses.
- [A Google Forms AI agent that handles every response for you](https://50agents.com/integrations/google-forms) ([markdown](https://50agents.com/integrations/google-forms.md)): With 50agents, a Google Forms AI agent picks up each new response, replies to the person, logs it to a sheet, tells your team in Slack and starts the next step in apps like HubSpot, Google Calendar and Trello, across the 2,300+ apps you already use.
- [A Google Sheets AI agent that keeps your sheet up to date for you](https://50agents.com/integrations/google-sheets) ([markdown](https://50agents.com/integrations/google-sheets.md)): With 50agents, a Google Sheets AI agent adds rows from your leads and payments, updates the right row when something changes, chases follow-ups and sends weekly summaries, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses.
- [AI agents for Slack that do the chores, not just chat](https://50agents.com/integrations/slack) ([markdown](https://50agents.com/integrations/slack.md)): With 50agents, a Slack AI agent posts the updates, asks for approvals with buttons, answers when someone mentions it and logs what matters to a sheet, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses.
- [An AI agent for TallyPrime that chases dues and logs your vouchers](https://50agents.com/integrations/tallyprime) ([markdown](https://50agents.com/integrations/tallyprime.md)): With 50agents, a TallyPrime AI agent sends payment reminders, logs sales and purchase vouchers in Google Sheets, alerts your team on Slack and emails statements to your accountant, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses.
